links.comparator_used: Single fixed operating threshold for all diseases (no explicit head-to-head with the vendor default; study explored adjusted thresholds per disease and screening scenario)
links.outcome: Rule-out capacity and workload reduction with adjusted thresholds in screening
links.effect: About 40% of cases correctly ruled out when screening for a single disease at sensitivity above 95% (exploratory analysis); optimized threshold gave overall sensitivity 85% and specificity 75.4%, AUC 0.84; for combined reading of all abnormalities only marginal workload reduction was achieved
links.tradeoff: Insufficient specificity limited workload reduction for combined multi-disease reading; performance varied by sex, age and comorbidity (possible bias in elderly and women); human supervision still required
links.quote: About 40% of cases could be ruled out correctly when screening for only one specific disease with a sensitivity above 95% in the exploratory analysis.

design_hint: alert threshold adjustment (local operating point selection)
